versions.changelog:
agent-otc-trade v0.1.0

- Initial release.
- Enables direct, over-the-counter token trades between agents, using Uniswap as the settlement layer.
- Verifies counterparty agent identity via ERC-8004 and checks trust tiers.
- Uses Uniswap pool pricing for fair, transparent OTC price discovery.
- Supports atomic, on-chain settlement—including cross-chain trades using ERC-7683 intents.
- Automatically records an audit trail for every trade, capturing counterparties, terms, and transaction details.
